intro: A Forsaken leader asks you to stop the Tarnished at Shadowvale in Tirisfal Glades. Their attacks deepen mistrust among the Forsaken and threaten a fledgling order’s place in Tirisfal.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Not all risen adventurers have acclimated well to our new existence, as you may have seen yourself already. Some have carried forward their prejudices from life, and continue to visit violence upon their fellow Forsaken.

As it stands we are mistrusted by our people who remember well the persecution inflicted by the living in the name of the light, and these attacks do not help. A number of these tarnished have taken up residence at Shadowvale to the southwest. End them and bring me their leader's head.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Tarnished threaten what little goodwill we have with the other Forsaken. As much as it pains me to cross blades with our former brothers and sisters, they must be stopped if our fledgling order is to survive.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent work, friend. Every time one of these Tarnished strike out and kill one of the Forsaken, it becomes that much easier for our detractors to stoke mistrust towards us adventurers. Eliminating them will help further our cause and solidify our place here in Tirisfal.
I suspect it may take a long time for us to be fully embraced by the Forsaken and the horde. It could take years... Or maybe even decades, but the best we can do is keep trying to prove ourselves.
